blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Parts of the Visayas will experience rains and thunderstorms on Thursday, October 22, due to Super Typhoon Rosal and its trough, the state weather bureau said. In its daily forecast, the Visayas Pagasa Regional Services Division (PRSD) said Northern and Eastern Samar would experience cloudy skies with scattered rains and thunderstorms throughout the day. Similar weather conditions are expected over Western Visayas, the Negros Island Region, and Palawan due to Rosal’s trough, or extension.
